```{r}
aapl <- read.csv("MacroTrends_Data_Download_AAPL.csv", skip = 14)
aapl$date <- as.Date(aapl$date)
aapl <- aapl[order(aapl$date), c("date", "close")]

stopifnot(!anyNA(aapl), !anyDuplicated(aapl$date))
```


```{r}
daily_baseline <- data.frame(
  forecast_date   = aapl$date,
  target_date     = dplyr::lead(aapl$date),
  predicted_close = aapl$close,
  actual_close    = dplyr::lead(aapl$close)
)

baseline_2025 <- subset(
  daily_baseline,
  target_date >= as.Date("2025-01-01") &
  target_date <  as.Date("2026-01-01")
)

baseline_2025$error <- baseline_2025$actual_close - baseline_2025$predicted_close
baseline_2025$abs_error <- abs(baseline_2025$error)

head(baseline_2025)

```

```{r}
baseline_scores_2025 <- data.frame(
  trading_days = nrow(baseline_2025),
  RMSE = sqrt(mean(baseline_2025$error^2)),
  MAE = mean(baseline_2025$abs_error),
  within_5_dollars_pct = 100 * mean(baseline_2025$abs_error <= 5)
)

print(round(baseline_scores_2025, 3))
```


```{r}
write.csv(baseline_2025, "AAPL_baseline_daily_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Step 2: Diagnose next-day AAPL forecast errors

prices <- read.csv("MacroTrends_Data_Download_AAPL.csv", skip = 14)
prices$date <- as.Date(prices$date)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(prices$date))

diagnostics <- baseline_2025
target_rows <- match(diagnostics$target_date, prices$date)

stopifnot(!anyNA(target_rows))
diagnostics$target_open <- prices$open[target_rows]
stopifnot(!anyNA(diagnostics$target_open))

diagnostics$overnight_gap <- diagnostics$target_open -
                             diagnostics$predicted_close

diagnostics$intraday_move <- diagnostics$actual_close -
                             diagnostics$target_open

stopifnot(all(abs(diagnostics$overnight_gap +
                  diagnostics$intraday_move -
                  diagnostics$error) < 1e-8))

moves <- list(
  overnight = diagnostics$overnight_gap,
  intraday = diagnostics$intraday_move,
  full_day = diagnostics$error
)

movement_summary <- data.frame(
  period = names(moves),
  mean_abs_move_usd = sapply(moves, function(x) mean(abs(x))),
  rms_move_usd = sapply(moves, function(x) sqrt(mean(x^2))),
  row.names = NULL
)

print(movement_summary, digits = 4)


ranked_rows <- order(diagnostics$abs_error, decreasing = TRUE)
worst_10 <- diagnostics[head(ranked_rows, 10), ]

worst_10$larger_move <- with(
  worst_10,
  ifelse(abs(overnight_gap) > abs(intraday_move), "Overnight",
         ifelse(abs(intraday_move) > abs(overnight_gap), "Intraday", "Equal"))
)

worst_10 <- worst_10[, c(
  "forecast_date", "target_date", "predicted_close",
  "target_open", "actual_close", "overnight_gap",
  "intraday_move", "error", "abs_error", "larger_move"
)]

print(worst_10, row.names = FALSE)

tail_summary <- data.frame(
  total_days = nrow(diagnostics),
  worst_days = nrow(worst_10),
  pct_of_total_squared_error =
    100 * sum(worst_10$error^2) / sum(diagnostics$error^2),
  intraday_larger_days = sum(worst_10$larger_move == "Intraday"),
  overnight_larger_days = sum(worst_10$larger_move == "Overnight")
)

print(round(tail_summary, 2))

write.csv(diagnostics, "AAPL_error_diagnostics_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(worst_10, "AAPL_worst_10_days_2025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Load AAPL and QQQ daily prices
daily <- read.csv("MacroTrends_Data_Download_AAPL.csv", skip = 14)
qqq <- read.csv("QQQ_daily.csv")

daily$date <- as.Date(daily$date)
qqq$date <- as.Date(qqq$date)

daily <- daily[order(daily$date), ]
qqq <- qqq[order(qqq$date), ]

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(daily$date), !anyDuplicated(qqq$date))

# Calculate QQQ returns on its own trading calendar
qqq$qqq_ret_1d <- qqq$qqq_close / dplyr::lag(qqq$qqq_close, 1) - 1
qqq$qqq_ret_5d <- qqq$qqq_close / dplyr::lag(qqq$qqq_close, 5) - 1

# Match QQQ features by date while preserving every AAPL trading day
qqq_rows <- match(daily$date, qqq$date)
daily$qqq_ret_1d <- qqq$qqq_ret_1d[qqq_rows]
daily$qqq_ret_5d <- qqq$qqq_ret_5d[qqq_rows]

# Build features available after the current trading session closes
daily$aapl_ret_1d <- daily$close / dplyr::lag(daily$close, 1) - 1
daily$aapl_ret_5d <- daily$close / dplyr::lag(daily$close, 5) - 1
daily$intraday_return <- daily$close / daily$open - 1

daily_range <- daily$high - daily$low
daily$close_position <- (daily$close - daily$low) /
  dplyr::na_if(daily_range, 0) - 0.5

daily$volatility_20d <- zoo::rollapplyr(
  daily$aapl_ret_1d, width = 20, FUN = sd, fill = NA
)

# Compare today's volume with the mean of the previous 20 sessions
prior_avg_volume <- zoo::rollmeanr(
  dplyr::lag(daily$volume), k = 20, fill = NA
)
daily$relative_volume <- daily$volume / prior_avg_volume

# Keep future outcomes separate from all predictor lists
daily$target_date <- dplyr::lead(daily$date)
daily$actual_close <- dplyr::lead(daily$close)
daily$next_return <- daily$actual_close / daily$close - 1
```



```{r}
# Define feature sets before evaluating any models
price_features <- c(
  "aapl_ret_1d", "aapl_ret_5d", "intraday_return", "close_position"
)

feature_sets <- list(
  AAPL_price = price_features,
  AAPL_price_volatility = c(price_features, "volatility_20d"),
  AAPL_price_volatility_volume = c(
    price_features, "volatility_20d", "relative_volume"
  ),
  AAPL_price_QQQ = c(price_features, "qqq_ret_1d", "qqq_ret_5d")
)

# Evaluate by target date so the 2025 sample matches Step 1
evaluation_rows <- which(
  daily$target_date >= as.Date("2023-01-01") &
  daily$target_date < as.Date("2026-01-01")
)

window_size <- 756L
all_features <- unique(unlist(feature_sets, use.names = FALSE))

# Check that all models can use the same dates and full training windows
required_rows <- seq.int(
  min(evaluation_rows) - window_size, max(evaluation_rows)
)

feature_values <- as.matrix(daily[required_rows, all_features])
if (any(!is.finite(feature_values))) {
  missing_columns <- colnames(feature_values)[
    colSums(!is.finite(feature_values)) > 0
  ]
  stop("Missing or non-finite feature values in: ",
       paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

stopifnot(all(is.finite(daily$next_return[required_rows])))

# Store one row per forecast origin and one column per model
predictions <- daily[evaluation_rows, c("date", "target_date", "actual_close")]
names(predictions)[1] <- "forecast_date"
predictions$Baseline <- daily$close[evaluation_rows]

for (model_name in names(feature_sets)) {
  features_used <- feature_sets[[model_name]]
  model_formula <- reformulate(features_used, response = "next_return")
  predicted_close <- numeric(length(evaluation_rows))

  for (j in seq_along(evaluation_rows)) {
    i <- evaluation_rows[j]

    # At today's close, yesterday is the latest fully labeled training row
    train_rows <- seq.int(i - window_size, i - 1L)
    fit <- lm(model_formula, data = daily[train_rows, ])

    predicted_return <- predict(fit, newdata = daily[i, , drop = FALSE])
    predicted_close[j] <- daily$close[i] * (1 + predicted_return)
  }

  predictions[[model_name]] <- predicted_close
}
```



```{r}
# Score all models on identical target dates
model_names <- c("Baseline", names(feature_sets))
predictions$year <- as.integer(format(predictions$target_date, "%Y"))
score_rows <- list()

for (yr in sort(unique(predictions$year))) {
  period <- predictions[predictions$year == yr, ]
  baseline_error <- period$actual_close - period$Baseline
  baseline_rmse <- sqrt(mean(baseline_error^2))

  for (model_name in model_names) {
    error <- period$actual_close - period[[model_name]]
    rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2))

    score_rows[[length(score_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      year = yr,
      model = model_name,
      days = length(error),
      RMSE = rmse,
      MAE = mean(abs(error)),
      RMSE_gain_vs_baseline = baseline_rmse - rmse,
      within_5_dollars_pct = 100 * mean(abs(error) <= 5),
      beats_baseline_days_pct = if (model_name == "Baseline") {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        100 * mean(abs(error) < abs(baseline_error))
      }
    )
  }
}

scores <- do.call(rbind, score_rows)

# Print the 2025 results from lowest to highest RMSE
scores_2025 <- subset(scores, year == 2025)
scores_2025 <- scores_2025[order(scores_2025$RMSE), ]
print(scores_2025, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE)

# Compare annual RMSE to check whether the ranking repeats across years
annual_rmse <- reshape(
  scores[, c("model", "year", "RMSE")],
  idvar = "model", timevar = "year", direction = "wide"
)
print(annual_rmse, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE)

# Save both the daily predictions and the model comparison
write.csv(predictions, "AAPL_step3_daily_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(scores, "AAPL_step3_model_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Step 4A: Retrieve the final 30 minutes of one regular trading session
sample_date <- "2025-12-15"
market_tz <- "America/New_York"
symbols <- c("AAPL", "QQQ")

# Convert New York session times to UTC for the API request
start_time <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(sample_date, "15:30:00"), tz = market_tz
)
end_time <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(sample_date, "15:59:59"), tz = market_tz
)

request <- httr2::request(
  "https://data.alpaca.markets/v2/stocks/bars"
) |>
  httr2::req_headers(
    `APCA-API-KEY-ID` = Sys.getenv("APCA_API_KEY_ID"),
    `APCA-API-SECRET-KEY` = Sys.getenv("APCA_API_SECRET_KEY")
  ) |>
  httr2::req_url_query(
    symbols = paste(symbols, collapse = ","),
    timeframe = "1Min",
    start = format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
    end = format(end_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
    feed = "sip",
    adjustment = "raw",
    sort = "asc",
    limit = 1000
  )

response <- httr2::req_perform(request)
payload <- httr2::resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = TRUE)

# Check that the response contains both symbols
stopifnot(all(symbols %in% names(payload$bars)))

minute_sample <- do.call(rbind, lapply(symbols, function(symbol) {
  bars <- payload$bars[[symbol]]
  timestamps <- as.POSIXct(
    bars$t, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"
  )

  data.frame(
    symbol = symbol,
    time_et = format(timestamps, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = market_tz),
    open = bars$o,
    close = bars$c,
    volume = bars$v
  )
}))

# Verify every expected minute before calculating the features
expected_minutes <- format(
  seq(start_time, by = "min", length.out = 30),
  "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = market_tz
)

sample_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(symbols, function(symbol) {
  x <- minute_sample[minute_sample$symbol == symbol, ]
  x <- x[order(x$time_et), ]

  if (!identical(x$time_et, expected_minutes)) {
    stop("Missing or duplicated minute bars for ", symbol)
  }

  data.frame(
    symbol = symbol,
    bars = nrow(x),
    first_minute = x$time_et[1],
    last_minute = tail(x$time_et, 1),
    return_30m_pct = 100 * (tail(x$close, 1) / x$open[1] - 1),
    volume_30m = sum(x$volume)
  )
}))

print(sample_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```





```{r}
# Step 4B: Build one row of closing-window features per trading session

# Get the actual closing time for each trading day in December 2025
calendar_request <- httr2::request(
  "https://paper-api.alpaca.markets/v2/calendar"
) |>
  httr2::req_headers(
    `APCA-API-KEY-ID` = Sys.getenv("APCA_API_KEY_ID"),
    `APCA-API-SECRET-KEY` = Sys.getenv("APCA_API_SECRET_KEY")
  ) |>
  httr2::req_url_query(start = "2025-12-01", end = "2025-12-31")

calendar <- calendar_request |>
  httr2::req_perform() |>
  httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

stopifnot(nrow(calendar) > 0, !anyDuplicated(calendar$date))

# Retrieve the final 30 one-minute bars for both symbols
get_closing_features <- function(trading_date, close_time) {
  close_et <- as.POSIXct(
    paste(trading_date, close_time),
    format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
    tz = "America/New_York"
  )
  start_et <- close_et - 30 * 60
  expected_times <- as.numeric(start_et) + (0:29) * 60

  day_request <- request |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      start = format(start_et, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC"),
      end = format(close_et - 1, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
    ) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 4)

  bars_by_symbol <- day_request |>
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

  result <- data.frame(
    forecast_date = as.Date(trading_date),
    session_close_et = close_time
  )

  for (symbol in c("AAPL", "QQQ")) {
    bars <- bars_by_symbol$bars[[symbol]]
    prefix <- tolower(symbol)
    n_bars <- if (is.null(bars)) 0L else nrow(bars)

    # Keep incomplete sessions visible and leave their features missing
    result[[paste0(prefix, "_bars")]] <- n_bars
    result[[paste0(prefix, "_ret_30m")]] <- NA_real_
    result[[paste0(prefix, "_volume_30m")]] <- NA_real_

    if (n_bars != 30L) next

    times <- as.POSIXct(
      bars$t, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"
    )
    idx <- order(times)
    if (!identical(as.numeric(times[idx]), expected_times)) next

    bars <- bars[idx, ]
    result[[paste0(prefix, "_ret_30m")]] <- bars$c[30] / bars$o[1] - 1
    result[[paste0(prefix, "_volume_30m")]] <- sum(bars$v)
  }

  result$relative_ret_30m <- result$aapl_ret_30m - result$qqq_ret_30m
  result
}

# Build the monthly feature table in trading-date order
daily_rows <- Map(get_closing_features, calendar$date, calendar$close)
closing_features_dec <- do.call(rbind, daily_rows)
closing_features_dec <- closing_features_dec[
  order(closing_features_dec$forecast_date), 
]
rownames(closing_features_dec) <- NULL

# Check coverage and compare the sample day with Step 4A
print(data.frame(
  trading_days = nrow(closing_features_dec),
  complete_days = sum(!is.na(closing_features_dec$relative_ret_30m))
))

print(subset(closing_features_dec, forecast_date == as.Date("2025-12-15")))
print(subset(closing_features_dec, session_close_et != "16:00"))

write.csv(
  closing_features_dec,
  "AAPL_QQQ_closing_features_2025_12.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```



```{r}
# Step 4C: Download historical closing-window features with monthly checkpoints

start_date <- "2019-11-01"
end_date <- "2025-12-31"

cache_dir <- "closing_window_monthly"
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Get the official trading dates and closing times for the full period
full_calendar <- calendar_request |>
  httr2::req_url_query(start = start_date, end = end_date) |>
  httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 4) |>
  httr2::req_perform() |>
  httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

full_calendar$date <- as.Date(full_calendar$date)
full_calendar <- full_calendar[order(full_calendar$date), ]
stopifnot(nrow(full_calendar) > 0, !anyDuplicated(full_calendar$date))

calendar_by_month <- split(
  full_calendar,
  format(full_calendar$date, "%Y-%m")
)

required_cols <- c(
  "forecast_date", "session_close_et",
  "aapl_bars", "aapl_ret_30m", "aapl_volume_30m",
  "qqq_bars", "qqq_ret_30m", "qqq_volume_30m",
  "relative_ret_30m"
)

# A saved month must contain exactly one row per scheduled trading day
valid_month <- function(x, sessions) {
  all(required_cols %in% names(x)) &&
    identical(as.character(x$forecast_date), as.character(sessions$date)) &&
    identical(as.character(x$session_close_et), as.character(sessions$close))
}

monthly_data <- vector("list", length(calendar_by_month))
names(monthly_data) <- names(calendar_by_month)

for (month in names(calendar_by_month)) {
  sessions <- calendar_by_month[[month]]
  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(month, ".csv"))
  monthly <- NULL

  # Reuse the December sample from Step 4B when available
  source_file <- cache_file
  if (!file.exists(source_file) && month == "2025-12") {
    source_file <- "AAPL_QQQ_closing_features_2025_12.csv"
  }

  if (file.exists(source_file)) {
    saved <- read.csv(source_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (valid_month(saved, sessions)) {
      monthly <- saved[, required_cols]
    }
  }

  if (is.null(monthly)) {
    message("Downloading ", month, " (", nrow(sessions), " sessions)")

    rows <- vector("list", nrow(sessions))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(sessions))) {
      rows[[i]] <- get_closing_features(
        as.character(sessions$date[i]),
        sessions$close[i]
      )
      Sys.sleep(0.35)
    }

    monthly <- do.call(rbind, rows)
    stopifnot(valid_month(monthly, sessions))
  } else {
    message("Using saved data for ", month)
  }

  # Write the checkpoint only after the entire month has been processed
  monthly$forecast_date <- as.Date(monthly$forecast_date)
  if (!identical(source_file, cache_file) || !file.exists(cache_file) ||
      is.null(monthly_data[[month]]) && exists("saved") &&
      !valid_month(saved, sessions)) {
    tmp <- tempfile(tmpdir = cache_dir, fileext = ".csv")
    write.csv(monthly, tmp, row.names = FALSE)
    stopifnot(file.rename(tmp, cache_file))
  }

  monthly_data[[month]] <- monthly
}

# Combine all months and check that no trading dates were lost or duplicated
closing_history <- do.call(rbind, unname(monthly_data))
closing_history <- closing_history[order(closing_history$forecast_date), ]
rownames(closing_history) <- NULL

stopifnot(identical(closing_history$forecast_date, full_calendar$date))

# Report feature coverage by year and retain incomplete sessions for inspection
complete_features <- complete.cases(closing_history[, c(
  "aapl_ret_30m", "aapl_volume_30m",
  "qqq_ret_30m", "qqq_volume_30m"
)])

coverage <- aggregate(
  cbind(trading_days = rep(1L, nrow(closing_history)),
        complete_days = as.integer(complete_features)),
  by = list(year = format(closing_history$forecast_date, "%Y")),
  FUN = sum
)

coverage$missing_days <- coverage$trading_days - coverage$complete_days
print(coverage, row.names = FALSE)

if (any(!complete_features)) {
  print(closing_history[!complete_features, c(
    "forecast_date", "session_close_et", "aapl_bars", "qqq_bars"
  )], row.names = FALSE)
}

write.csv(
  closing_history,
  "AAPL_QQQ_closing_features_history.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```



```{r}
# Step 4D: Test the incremental value of the closing-window relative return

# Load saved intraday features and the original Step 3 predictions
closing <- read.csv("AAPL_QQQ_closing_features_history.csv")
closing$forecast_date <- as.Date(closing$forecast_date)

results <- read.csv("AAPL_step3_model_scores.csv")  # Annual reference scores
old_preds <- read.csv("AAPL_step3_daily_predictions.csv")
old_preds$forecast_date <- as.Date(old_preds$forecast_date)
old_preds$target_date <- as.Date(old_preds$target_date)

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(closing$forecast_date),
  !anyDuplicated(old_preds$forecast_date),
  !anyDuplicated(daily$date),
  !is.unsorted(daily$date)
)

# Match the intraday feature to the session in which it was observed
model_daily <- daily
closing_rows <- match(model_daily$date, closing$forecast_date)
model_daily$relative_ret_30m <- closing$relative_ret_30m[closing_rows]

# Use the exact forecast dates and actual outcomes scored in Step 3
evaluation <- old_preds[, c(
  "forecast_date", "target_date", "actual_close", "Baseline", "AAPL_price"
)]
origin_rows <- match(evaluation$forecast_date, model_daily$date)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(origin_rows),
  all(model_daily$target_date[origin_rows] == evaluation$target_date),
  all(abs(model_daily$actual_close[origin_rows] - evaluation$actual_close) < 1e-8)
)

# Add only one predictor to the original price regression
new_features <- c(
  "aapl_ret_1d", "aapl_ret_5d", "intraday_return",
  "close_position", "relative_ret_30m"
)
new_formula <- reformulate(new_features, response = "next_return")
window_size <- 756L

# Check feature coverage across every training and prediction window
required_rows <- seq.int(min(origin_rows) - window_size, max(origin_rows))
stopifnot(
  min(required_rows) >= 1L,
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(model_daily[required_rows, new_features]))),
  all(is.finite(model_daily$next_return[required_rows]))
)

# Refit after each close using only outcomes observed by that session
evaluation$AAPL_price_close30 <- NA_real_

for (j in seq_along(origin_rows)) {
  i <- origin_rows[j]
  train_rows <- seq.int(i - window_size, i - 1L)

  fit <- lm(new_formula, data = model_daily[train_rows, ])
  predicted_return <- predict(fit, newdata = model_daily[i, , drop = FALSE])

  evaluation$AAPL_price_close30[j] <-
    model_daily$close[i] * (1 + predicted_return)
}

# Compare paired errors on the same target dates within each year
evaluation$year <- format(evaluation$target_date, "%Y")
by_year <- split(evaluation, evaluation$year)

comparison_4d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(by_year, function(x) {
  base_error <- x$actual_close - x$Baseline
  price_error <- x$actual_close - x$AAPL_price
  new_error <- x$actual_close - x$AAPL_price_close30

  price_rmse <- sqrt(mean(price_error^2))
  new_rmse <- sqrt(mean(new_error^2))

  data.frame(
    year = x$year[1],
    days = nrow(x),
    baseline_RMSE = sqrt(mean(base_error^2)),
    price_RMSE = price_rmse,
    close30_RMSE = new_rmse,
    RMSE_gain_vs_price = price_rmse - new_rmse,
    MAE_gain_vs_price = mean(abs(price_error)) - mean(abs(new_error)),
    beats_price_days_pct = 100 * mean(abs(new_error) < abs(price_error))
  )
}))

# Verify that the reference RMSE matches the saved Step 3 scores
reference <- subset(results, model == "AAPL_price")
reference_rows <- match(comparison_4d$year, as.character(reference$year))
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(reference_rows),
  all(abs(comparison_4d$price_RMSE - reference$RMSE[reference_rows]) < 1e-8)
)

print(comparison_4d, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(evaluation, "AAPL_step4d_daily_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(comparison_4d, "AAPL_step4d_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Step 4E: Test closing-window relative volume against the price-only model

# Use the previous 20 regular sessions as the volume reference
closing <- closing[order(closing$forecast_date), ]
regular <- which(closing$session_close_et == "16:00")
regular_volume <- closing$aapl_volume_30m[regular]

prior_avg <- zoo::rollmeanr(
  dplyr::lag(regular_volume), k = 20, fill = NA
)

# Zero represents neutral volume on an early-close session
closing$log_relative_volume_30m <- 0
closing$log_relative_volume_30m[regular] <- log(regular_volume / prior_avg)

# Align each feature with its forecast origin
idx <- match(model_daily$date, closing$forecast_date)
model_daily$log_relative_volume_30m <- closing$log_relative_volume_30m[idx]

# Use the same price predictors, forecast dates, and window as Step 4D
volume_features <- c(
  "aapl_ret_1d", "aapl_ret_5d", "intraday_return",
  "close_position", "log_relative_volume_30m"
)
volume_formula <- reformulate(volume_features, response = "next_return")
window_size <- 756L

required_rows <- seq.int(min(origin_rows) - window_size, max(origin_rows))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(as.matrix(model_daily[required_rows, volume_features]))))

# Predict next-session returns and convert them to closing prices
evaluation$AAPL_price_volume30 <- NA_real_

for (j in seq_along(origin_rows)) {
  i <- origin_rows[j]
  train_rows <- seq.int(i - window_size, i - 1L)

  fit <- lm(volume_formula, data = model_daily[train_rows, ])
  predicted_return <- predict(fit, newdata = model_daily[i, , drop = FALSE])

  evaluation$AAPL_price_volume30[j] <-
    model_daily$close[i] * (1 + predicted_return)
}

# Compare paired errors against the price-only model for each year
rmse <- function(error) sqrt(mean(error^2))

comparison_4e <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(evaluation, evaluation$year), function(x) {
  price_error <- x$actual_close - x$AAPL_price
  volume_error <- x$actual_close - x$AAPL_price_volume30

  data.frame(
    year = x$year[1],
    days = nrow(x),
    baseline_RMSE = rmse(x$actual_close - x$Baseline),
    price_RMSE = rmse(price_error),
    volume30_RMSE = rmse(volume_error),
    RMSE_gain_vs_price = rmse(price_error) - rmse(volume_error),
    MAE_gain_vs_price = mean(abs(price_error)) - mean(abs(volume_error)),
    beats_price_days_pct = 100 * mean(abs(volume_error) < abs(price_error))
  )
}))

print(comparison_4e, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(evaluation, "AAPL_step4e_daily_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(comparison_4e, "AAPL_step4e_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Step 5A: Compare rolling ridge regression with the existing price forecasts
price_features <- c(
  "aapl_ret_1d", "aapl_ret_5d", "intraday_return", "close_position"
)

window_size <- 756L
lambda <- 1

# Match each forecast to the trading day on which it was made
stopifnot(
  !is.unsorted(model_daily$date),
  !anyDuplicated(model_daily$date),
  !anyDuplicated(evaluation$forecast_date)
)

origin_rows <- match(evaluation$forecast_date, model_daily$date)
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(origin_rows),
  all(origin_rows > window_size),
  all(model_daily$target_date[origin_rows] == evaluation$target_date)
)

x <- as.matrix(model_daily[, price_features])
y <- model_daily$next_return

# Standardize each feature using only the current training window
predict_ridge_close <- function(i) {
  train <- seq.int(i - window_size, i - 1L)
  x_train <- x[train, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y[train]

  # The most recent training outcome must be known by today's close
  stopifnot(
    max(model_daily$target_date[train]) <= model_daily$date[i],
    all(is.finite(x_train)),
    all(is.finite(y_train)),
    all(is.finite(x[i, ]))
  )

  center <- colMeans(x_train)
  spread <- apply(x_train, 2, sd)
  stopifnot(all(spread > 0))

  z_train <- scale(x_train, center = center, scale = spread)
  z_today <- (x[i, ] - center) / spread

  # Penalize the slopes while leaving the intercept unpenalized
  mean_return <- mean(y_train)
  penalty <- window_size * lambda * diag(ncol(z_train))
  slopes <- solve(
    crossprod(z_train) + penalty,
    crossprod(z_train, y_train - mean_return)
  )

  predicted_return <- mean_return + sum(z_today * slopes)
  model_daily$close[i] * (1 + predicted_return)
}

evaluation$AAPL_ridge <- vapply(origin_rows, predict_ridge_close, numeric(1))

# Score all three forecasts on exactly the same target dates
model_names <- c("Baseline", "AAPL_price", "AAPL_ridge")
score_period <- function(d, period) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(model_names, function(model) {
    error <- d[[model]] - d$actual_close
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(error)))

    data.frame(
      period = period,
      model = model,
      days = length(error),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean(error^2)),
      MAE = mean(abs(error)),
      within_5_days = sum(abs(error) <= 5),
      within_5_pct = 100 * mean(abs(error) <= 5)
    )
  }))
}

by_year <- split(evaluation, format(evaluation$target_date, "%Y"))
annual_scores <- Map(score_period, by_year, names(by_year))
scores_5a <- do.call(rbind, c(
  unname(annual_scores),
  list(score_period(evaluation, "All years"))
))
rownames(scores_5a) <- NULL

write.csv(evaluation, "AAPL_step5a_daily_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(scores_5a, "AAPL_step5a_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(scores_5a, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Step 5B: Test shallow boosted trees on the same four price features
# Run install.packages("xgboost") in the Console if needed.

xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  tree_method = "hist",
  max_depth = 2L,
  min_child_weight = 30,
  eta = 0.05,
  max_bin = 64L,
  base_score = 0,
  nthread = 1L,
  seed = 586L
)

predict_xgb_close <- function(i) {
  train <- seq.int(i - window_size, i - 1L)

  # All training outcomes must be observable by the forecast close.
  stopifnot(max(model_daily$target_date[train]) <= model_daily$date[i])

  dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
    data = x[train, , drop = FALSE],
    label = y[train],
    nthread = 1L
  )
  dtoday <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(
    data = x[i, , drop = FALSE],
    nthread = 1L
  )

  fit <- xgboost::xgb.train(
    params = xgb_params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 30L,
    verbose = 0L
  )

  predicted_return <- as.numeric(predict(fit, dtoday))
  model_daily$close[i] * (1 + predicted_return)
}

evaluation$AAPL_xgb <- vapply(origin_rows, predict_xgb_close, numeric(1))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(evaluation$AAPL_xgb)))

    period = period,
    model = "AAPL_xgb",
    days = nrow(d),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(error^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(error)),
    within_5_days = sum(abs(error) <= 5),
    within_5_pct = 100 * mean(abs(error) <= 5)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Step 6A: Forecast the closing price after the opening price is observed
prices <- read.csv("MacroTrends_Data_Download_AAPL.csv", skip = 14)
prices$date <- as.Date(prices$date)
prices <- prices[order(prices$date), c("date", "open", "close")]
stopifnot(!anyNA(prices$date), !anyDuplicated(prices$date))

# Build each feature using information available at the opening forecast time.
prices$previous_close <- c(NA_real_, head(prices$close, -1))
prices$overnight_return <- prices$open / prices$previous_close - 1
prices$intraday_return <- prices$close / prices$open - 1

# Use the exact target dates from Step 5B for a paired comparison.
target_rows <- match(as.Date(evaluation$target_date), prices$date)
window_size <- 756L

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(target_rows),
  !anyDuplicated(target_rows),
  all(target_rows > window_size + 1L),
  isTRUE(all.equal(prices$close[target_rows], evaluation$actual_close,
                   check.attributes = FALSE)),
  isTRUE(all.equal(prices$previous_close[target_rows], evaluation$Baseline,
                   check.attributes = FALSE))
)

# Train through yesterday's close and predict today's open-to-close return.
predict_from_open <- function(i) {
  train_rows <- seq.int(i - window_size, i - 1L)
  train <- prices[train_rows, c("overnight_return", "intraday_return")]
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(as.matrix(train))),
            is.finite(prices$overnight_return[i]))

  fit <- lm(intraday_return ~ overnight_return, data = train)
  today <- data.frame(overnight_return = prices$overnight_return[i])
  predicted_return <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = today))

  prices$open[i] * (1 + predicted_return)
}

open_eval <- data.frame(
  target_date = prices$date[target_rows],
  actual_close = prices$close[target_rows],
  Previous_close = prices$previous_close[target_rows],
  Opening_price = prices$open[target_rows],
  Opening_gap_regression = vapply(target_rows, predict_from_open, numeric(1))
)

# Compare the two opening forecasts and retain the prior-close reference.
score_open_period <- function(d, period) {
  models <- c("Previous_close", "Opening_price", "Opening_gap_regression")
  open_rmse <- sqrt(mean((d$Opening_price - d$actual_close)^2))

  do.call(rbind, lapply(models, function(model) {
    error <- d[[model]] - d$actual_close
    rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2))

    data.frame(
      period = period,
      model = model,
      days = nrow(d),
      RMSE = rmse,
      MAE = mean(abs(error)),
      within_5_days = sum(abs(error) <= 5),
      within_5_pct = 100 * mean(abs(error) <= 5),
      RMSE_gain_vs_open = if (model == "Previous_close") NA_real_ else open_rmse - rmse
    )
  }))
}

open_years <- split(open_eval, format(open_eval$target_date, "%Y"))
open_annual <- Map(score_open_period, open_years, names(open_years))
open_scores <- do.call(rbind, c(
  unname(open_annual),
  list(score_open_period(open_eval, "All years"))
))
rownames(open_scores) <- NULL

write.csv(open_eval, "AAPL_step6a_open_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(open_scores, "AAPL_step6a_open_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(open_scores, digits = 6, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Step 7: Record the opening update for the November 23 forecast.
record_nov23_open <- function() {
  market_tz <- "America/New_York"
  target_date <- "2026-11-23"
  previous_close <- 342.56

  # Freeze the coefficients fitted through November 20.
  intercept <- 0.00104003
  gap_slope <- -0.18648603

  output_file <- "AAPL_open_forecast_2026-11-23.csv"

  # Return the original record if this function is run again.
  if (file.exists(output_file)) {
    return(read.csv(output_file))
  }

  session_open <- as.POSIXct(paste(target_date, "09:30:00"), tz = market_tz)
  session_close <- as.POSIXct(paste(target_date, "16:00:00"), tz = market_tz)
  in_session <- function(time) time >= session_open && time < session_close

  if (!in_session(Sys.time())) {
    stop("Record the opening forecast during the November 23 regular session.")
  }

  opening_price <- as.numeric(readline("Enter the official AAPL opening price: "))
  stopifnot(length(opening_price) == 1L, is.finite(opening_price), opening_price > 0)

  issued_at <- Sys.time()
  stopifnot(in_session(issued_at))

  overnight_return <- opening_price / previous_close - 1
  predicted_close <- opening_price * (1 + intercept + gap_slope * overnight_return)

  record <- data.frame(
    target_date = target_date,
    issued_at_et = format(issued_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z", tz = market_tz),
    previous_close = previous_close,
    official_open = opening_price,
    overnight_gap_pct = 100 * overnight_return,
    opening_baseline = opening_price,
    gap_model_forecast = round(predicted_close, 2)
  )

  write.csv(record, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  record
}
```
